rules.citation: city’s Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO); LAMC Section 151.28
rules.effective_date_basis: Effective February 2, 2026, the landlord can no longer include an additional percentage increase for utilities.
rules.title: RSO limits on rent increases
rules.requirement: For covered RSO rental units, rent generally may be increased only once every 12 months by the allowable rent-increase percentage, and landlords may no longer add an additional utility percentage after February 2, 2026. The page also states that RSO rent increases were prohibited from March 30, 2020 through January 31, 2024, and lists specified surcharges and cost-recovery programs.
rules.key_value: once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage

coverage.other_unresolvable: Replacement units under LAMC Section 151.28; hotel, motel, rooming house, or boarding-house rooms occupied by the same tenant for more than 30 consecutive days; condominium and townhome rent amounts are not regulated for tenancies that commenced after December 31, 1995.
coverage.summary: Generally applies to Los Angeles rental properties first built on or before October 1, 1978, replacement units under LAMC Section 151.28, and listed housing types including apartments, duplexes, certain condos and townhomes, mobile homes, ADUs, JADUs, and qualifying long-term hotel or rooming-house occupancies.

rules.exemptions: Rent may be increased to market rate if the tenant voluntarily moves out, is evicted for nonpayment, lease violation, failure to comply with a Tenant Habitability Plan, or a City Attorney order, or accepts a Tenant Buyout Agreement; rent amounts are not regulated for condominium and townhome tenancies that commenced after December 31, 1995; landlords may apply for a Luxury Exemption if they establish the monthly rent charged on or before May 31, 1978.
rules.interaction: The page states that properties not covered by the RSO may still be subject to the Just Cause Ordinance.

rules.title: RSO legal reasons for eviction
rules.requirement: For covered RSO rental units, landlords may evict only for listed legal reasons, including specified at-fault grounds and specified no-fault grounds. No-fault evictions require relocation assistance, and termination notices for RSO units must be filed with LAHD within three business days of service on the tenant.
rules.key_value: termination notices filed within 3 business days; no-fault evictions require relocation assistance
